Kaikki postprocessed per-language JSONL, deprecated upstream, not raw multilingual
Wiktextract. Exact article revisions are not supplied. Original headwords and
per-record source hashes are retained in repository evidence.
Credit: Tatu Ylonen, Wiktextract: Wiktionary as Machine-Readable Structured Data,
LREC 2022, pp. 1317–1325, https://www.lrec-conf.org/proceedings/lrec2022/pdf/2022.lrec-1.140.pdf

Modifications: retain attested lexical headwords, English senses, usage labels and
form/alternative relationships for 3–11 letters and historical spelling Zipf >=2.5.
Exclude proper-name POS and explicitly other-country-labelled senses. Omit source
media, examples, quotations, translations, etymology and enrichment categories.
Broader guesses include inflections and uncommon senses. Answer candidates require
Zipf >=4.3 and an eligible standalone sense, followed by explicit model editorial
review. Selected primary senses are exact source evidence. Runtime display retains
up to eight entries per original spelling and eight senses per entry. Bare unresolved
synonym references and explicitly reviewed defective glosses are omitted from runtime
meanings without removing their source evidence or guess membership.
Only Italian vowel accents À È É Ì Ò Ó Ù are folded for tile comparison. Original spelling is preserved for answers and definitions. Accent-equivalent headwords cannot compete as separate answers. Other diacritics, apostrophes and spaces are not stripped.

Frequency: wordfreq 3.0.2, Robyn Speer and contributors, pinned revision
372f6dbb3bd2ad4b675a3b18b94d44d0dd5fea8b.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rspeer/wordfreq/372f6dbb3bd2ad4b675a3b18b94d44d0dd5fea8b/wordfreq/data/small_it.msgpack.gz
SHA-256: 07a4355d735d9cc864ce9fe679d94a13dee4cefa2495b6b013ecdb214b231c66
Data CC BY-SA 4.0; this pinned release's software MIT. Complete pinned README and
MIT license accompany this notice. Preserve source credits, including OpenSubtitles,
freely available SUBTLEX and the acknowledgments to Marc Brysbaert and coauthors.
No corpus sentences are redistributed. Exact NFC case-normalized spelling uses
maximum supplied frequency, not an invented sum; no accent aliases in frequency.

Historical mixed-corpus frequencies are not individual-sense frequencies or proof
of exclusively Italy usage. Source labels and model review are incomplete;
this is a conservative starter, not native-human certification or an exhaustive
dictionary. See docs/italian-swedish-sources.md and src/data/italian/source.json in
https://github.com/intrepion/kata-inspired-by-wordle-codex-dot for pins and recipes.
Preserve attribution, modification notices and ShareAlike terms when redistributing
adapted data. These notices impose no additional restrictions.
